subject: Bluefin discovery — decision playbook & proposed milestones
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Sasha Green <sasha@bluefin.ai>, James O'Neill <james.oneill@bluefin.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bluefin discovery — decision playbook & proposed milestones

Thanks again for a focused discussion today — appreciate the level of detail on both the technical constraints and business timeline. Quick recap and a proposed decision playbook (MPA-style) so we have a shared artifact to iterate on. I attached a worksheet (redwood-mpa-v1.xlsx) that mirrors the table below.

Top pain points you called out:
- Production latency spikes during nightly batch scoring (95th percentile jump from ~120ms to ~450ms).
- Token-cost volatility across peak windows; need predictable unit economics for Q1 pilots.
- Auditability: compliance team needs retention controls and audit logs before Prod.

Primary goals (90-day horizon):
1) Pilot in staging with 50k monthly queries and SLO of p95 < 200ms for the online path.
2) Establish cost envelope and expected $/1000 tokens for both streaming & batch.
3) Validate security requirements (SOC2 + audit logs + VPC peering).

Proposed decision playbook (milestones & owners) — tentative dates: 
- Milestone A: Pilot scope & success criteria signed (owner: James) — target by 2026-11-30
- Milestone B: Security review completed (owner: Sasha / procurement) — target by 2026-12-07
- Milestone C: Staging run (runbook + load test) (owner: Laura/Eng) — target window 2026-12-14 to 2026-12-20
- Milestone D: Contract & pricing commitment (owner: Procurement) — target by 2026-12-22
- Milestone E: Prod rollout window agreement (owner: Bluefin PM / Rishi) — target by 2027-01-10

Decision process & committee:
- Technical committee: James (CTO), Laura (Redwood SE) for runbook validation.
- Procurement & legal: Sasha + procurement@bluefin.ai for T&Cs and contract cadence.
- Exec sponsor: Bluefin CFO / (tbd) — final sign-off for budget.

Asks for this week (concrete):
1) Sasha / James: confirm Milestone A date (is 11/30 achievable?)
2) Procurement: share any mandatory PO / contract clauses we should pre-seed into our SOW.
3) Bluefin security: we will share an initial security sample (attached) and can start the SOC2 evidence exchange once you confirm person to receive artifacts.

Next steps from our side:
- Laura will draft the uplifted runbook for staging load tests and share load-test script parameters.
- Monica will prepare onboarding checklist (SSO details, network, KMS).
- I will update the workbook and push a brief HubSpot note and DocuSign envelope for the SOW (link below).

If any of the milestone dates above are optimistic, call them out and we'll adjust. Thanks — aim to lock Milestone A early this week so engineering can block time.

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Bluefin discovery — decision playbook & proposed milestones

Thanks Rishi — very clear, and the worksheet is helpful. A few clarifications and adjustments from our side: 

1) Milestone A: we can commit to confirming scope by 2026-11-30 but that assumes James signs off on a short technical appendix by Friday (11/26). He asked for a one-page latency mitigation proposal — can Laura share that?

2) Security timeline: Procurement has a freeze on onboarding the first two weeks of December (internal audit). Can we move the Security review target to 12/14 instead of 12/07? If not, we may need to run a parallel pre-review.

3) Cost ask: please include a sample pricing sheet that separates streaming vs batch unit costs and an expected cost for the pilot volume (50k queries/month). That will help us model to the CFO.

4) Pain addendum: during batch windows we also see memory pressure on our side leading to queueing — we'd like to review your recommended model-quantization options and whether Redwood supports per-customer GPU limits in Dedicated mode.

Procurement: I have looped them in — procurement@bluefin.ai will send any standard clauses we need to include.

I'll confirm Milestone A by 11/30 pending James' tech appendix. Otherwise looks good.

—Sasha
Sasha Green
Director, Cloud Platform | Bluefin Analytics
